facts.statement: Annual celebrations were highlighted as part of the birthday event.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language SOE birthday post for Free Realms' second anniversary. It reports over 17 million registered users across PC, Mac and PlayStation 3, recalls the April 28, 2009 PC launch, and lists birthday-period features: new houses and lands, new careers, farming, annual celebrations, Robatesoros battles, and famous guest characters.
